categories.main_business_segments: The company operates two primary business segments: (1) Architectural engineering design and related consulting services, providing design services across residential, urban complexes, public buildings, and planning projects; (2) Non-academic vocational training services through its subsidiary Huatu Education Technology, offering recruitment examination training for civil servants, public institutions, medical, and education sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs Building Information Modeling (BIM) technology as a core competency, enabling multi-dimensional building information modeling and intelligent simulation analysis. The company also utilizes AI technology for educational applications including AI interview practice, AI essay grading, and AI problem analysis. Design services span from conceptual design through construction support phases.
categories.primary_customers_markets: For architectural design: real estate developers, government institutions, and multinational companies across residential, commercial, and public building sectors. For training services: university graduates, civil service examination candidates, medical professionals, and education sector employees seeking recruitment examination preparation and professional certifications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Chengdu, Sichuan Province. The architectural design business is based in western China with national reach. The training business operates across 300+ cities and 600+ counties nationwide through 1000+ learning centers, with particular strength in tier 4-5 cities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream/service provision position. For architectural design, it provides design services to real estate developers and construction companies. For training services, it operates as a direct service provider to end-user students and examination candidates.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Advancing BIM technology and green building design capabilities; (2) Developing AI-powered educational technology across teaching, learning, and assessment; (3) Expanding high-quality training products with emphasis on quality over volume; (4) Exploring emerging sectors including elderly care training and international education; (5) Strengthening scientific management systems and process optimization.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through: (1) Architectural design services charged on project basis with fees based on design phases and project complexity; (2) Non-academic training services through face-to-face classroom training, online courses, and hybrid models, with revenue recognized upon service delivery or course completion.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In architectural design, the company competes with other domestic design firms and international design companies, positioning itself as a leading regional player with BIM technology advantages. In training services, the company is a market leader in civil service examination training with strong brand recognition, competing against other national training chains and regional providers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved significant growth in 2024 with revenue of 2.83 billion yuan (up 1,046% from 247 million yuan in 2023), net profit of 53 million yuan (compared to -92 million yuan loss in 2023). Total assets reached 1.87 billion yuan (up 83% from 1.02 billion yuan). The company transitioned from loss-making to profitability through the integration of the training business.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: For architectural design: comprehensive full-cycle service capability, leading BIM technology application, and integrated design management coordinating multiple specialties. For training services: high-quality teaching content, scientific quality management system, extensive geographic coverage reaching tier 4-5 cities, strong brand reputation, and AI-enhanced learning experiences.
